left.title: Post-ABC Tracking Poll: Trump 46, Clinton 45, as Democratic enthusiasm dips
left.body: Hillary Clinton and Donald Trump are all but tied in the latest Washington Post-ABC News Tracking Poll, which finds Clinton backers slipping behind in enthusiasm even as the Democrat has an edge in early voting.
left.roundup: Republican presidential nominee Donald Trump now leads Hillary Clinton by one point, according to the latest ABC News/Washington Post national tracking poll.

center.title: Poll shows Trump made up 13 points in under 2 weeks — now he likes polls again
center.body: Donald Trump now leads Hillary Clinton for the first time since May, according to the ABC News/Washington Post daily tracking poll.
